method.walker: scripts/h64-controls.mjs --only <surface> (one surface per process; per-surface JSON appended here)
method.enumeration_bound: Exactly the 10 surfaces named on the card, one walk each. Controls are the visible (bounding box > 1 px) buttons/links/tabs/options/menuitems/switches/inputs/selects/textareas inside [data-cb-route] at the moment the surface was inventoried. Repeated rows with the same label+disabled state share one handler and are exercised once (recorded same-handler). Controls that write durable state or open a native picker are not clicked and are recorded unmeasured-destructive with the source guard. No surface was enumerated beyond this list; Sources, Export, open-section, Library and steps 2-3 of the create flow were walked by the script in prior runs but are outside this card’s bound and are not in this file.
method.noop_definition: A visible, enabled control that produced no route, dialog, notice or state change and that was not re-measured by a document-wide probe.
method.false_noop_protocol: The walker’s snapshot is scoped to [data-cb-route]; portalled menus/listboxes and sub-second re-renders therefore read as noop. Every noop the walker reported on this run was re-clicked with a document-wide probe (scratch h64-probe.mjs / h64-probe2.mjs, results transcribed in corrections[]), and none survived.

They also record a content-state fact: that section currently renders "This section has no teaching content yet" / "The check could not be opened".
